The explorer who reached America in 1492 is Christopher Columbus.

To enhance the artistic concept of a futuristic retail space using the provided guidelines, we can design a multi-sensory experience that immerses visitors in a seamless blend of technology and atmosphere. Upon entering, shoppers are immediately greeted by holographic product displays that float in mid-air, allowing them to view items from every angle without physical contact. Interactive touch screens embedded in the floor or walls enable customers to customize products or access detailed information with intuitive gestures.

The olfactory dimension is carefully curated with a subtle, clean technological scent, reminiscent of ozone or fresh linen, which evokes a sense of purity and innovation. This scent is diffused evenly throughout the space, ensuring it remains pleasant and unobtrusive.

Auditory engagement is achieved through a dynamic soundscape that adapts in real-time to the environment. The volume and tempo of the music or ambient sounds shift based on foot traffic density and the time of day, creating a calming atmosphere during quiet periods and an energetic vibe during peak hours. This responsive audio design ensures that the retail experience feels alive and attuned to the shoppers' presence, enhancing both comfort and engagement.
